verdict.rationale: Reflect's import/export docs state you can always export your notes into an open format such as HTML or Markdown. That covers the core of an anytime, open-format exit path. The claim rests on a single brief sentence, with no detail on scope or fidelity. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that the export covers the entire knowledge base including attachments and images, documentation of how backlinks and tags are preserved in the export, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the export working.
